final: WITH g AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS s FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref HAVING SUM(articount) IS NOT NULL), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS total FROM g WHERE s IS NOT NULL), f AS (SELECT g.zoneref AS zoneref, g.s AS s, CAST(g.s AS REAL) / t.total AS frac FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(frac) AS avgfrac FROM f WHERE frac IS NOT NULL) SELECT f.zoneref, f.s, f.frac, f.frac - a.avgfrac AS diff FROM f CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avgfrac IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (f.frac - a.avgfrac) IS NULL, (f.frac - a.avgfrac) DESC LIMIT 10
